translations.web: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
translations.bsb: but they did not find His body. They came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that Jesus was alive.
translations.kjv: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
translations.asv: and when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
